# Vendored browser libraries

`pptxgen.bundle.js` is the browser distribution from PptxGenJS v4.0.1. It is
loaded on demand by the presentation export controller. The bundle includes
JSZip, image-size, and tslib; their license texts are kept beside the bundle.

The source release is pinned at
<https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS/tree/v4.0.1/dist>.
